style: Style: calm, appetising professional still-life photograph, photorealistic, shot on a medium-format camera with a 90 mm lens. The subject stands on a matte deep petrol-blue surface in front of a seamless deep petrol-blue backdrop (colour around #003646 to #005670, the same continuous tone from floor to wall, no horizon line, no texture, no props beyond the subject). Soft single-source daylight from the upper left, a gentle long soft shadow falling to the lower right, no hard highlights. Camera at the same three-quarter angle slightly above table height across the whole set. Exactly one small fresh lime-green accent (colour family #C0E021) as described in the accent line; it is the only added bright colour, everything else keeps the food's own natural colours. Accent rule for the set: one small sprig of fresh dill by default; one small fresh mint leaf for sweet subjects and drinks; for non-food subjects no herb, only one small folded lime-green cloth or paper corner. Any packaging is completely plain and unbranded: plain white or plain kraft-paper cartons, sacks, tubs, bottles, tins and boxes with smooth blank surfaces. Professional-kitchen honesty: wholesale quantities where natural, functional and real, not retail kitsch, no decoration.

framing.tile: Square composition: the subject is large in the frame, filling about 60% of the square, centred, with a calm even margin of petrol-blue around it; the accent is small and sits beside the subject.
framing.department: Wide banner composition: the left 40% of the frame is quiet, empty petrol-blue surface and backdrop for overlaid type; the subject group is weighted to the right 60% of the frame, arranged in a calm low row with a little space between items. Every item sits fully inside the frame with a clear margin of backdrop on the right edge; nothing is cut off by the frame.
framing.hero: Wide banner composition: the left 40% of the frame is quiet, empty petrol-blue surface and backdrop for overlaid type; the subject group is weighted to the right 60% of the frame, generous and calm. Every item sits fully inside the frame with a clear margin of backdrop on the right edge; nothing is cut off by the frame.

accents.dill: Accent: one small sprig of fresh dill lying on the surface near the subject, the only herb in the image.
accents.mint: Accent: one small fresh mint leaf lying on the surface near the subject, the only herb in the image.
accents.cloth: Accent: one small neatly folded plain lime-green cotton cloth or paper corner beside the subject; no herbs, no food.

negative: Strictly no text of any kind: no letters, no words, no numbers, no logos, no labels, no stickers, no printed graphics, no barcodes, no brand marks, no embossing, no recognisable real-world brand packaging or pack shapes, no watermark, no signature. No people, no hands, no faces.

hero.subject: A generous wholesale delivery that has just arrived in a professional kitchen: a wooden crate of fresh vegetables (carrots trimmed with short stubby tops, a few cucumbers, a pale cabbage; few leaves, little green), a plain unprinted white gable-top milk carton, a large block of yellow cheese, a crusty rustic loaf of bread, and a heavy, flat-bottomed 10 kg plain kraft paper flour sack with a stitched top seam, standing upright and full.
